caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a powder flask, centrally placed on a plain, beige background. The flask has a teardrop shape with a dark brown body and a brass-colored cap and spout at the top. The body of the flask features a raised embossed design that includes an eagle with spread wings, a shield on its chest, and a banner beneath it, as well as crossed objects and foliage surrounding the eagle. There is a metallic hinge or clasp visible on the upper left of the cap. The overall color palette is composed of varying shades of brown and gold for the flask, and the background is a uniform light beige without any other elements or objects present.
title: Powder Horn
